messages:
priya: Heads-up 1: Customer Halcyon reported a short Dedicated isolation at 09:03 UTC. Symptoms line up with VPC peering route drop during on-prem appliance churn. Draft PM: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/halcyon-dedicated-draft. Want owners + timeline for remediation sweep.

owen: saw it. flap ~09:02-09:05. I'll take peering hardening (route validation + TTL + probe). Target: small staging canary by next Wed.

carmen: I'll investigate on-prem appliance interactions and a repro harness. Need Halcyon staging creds; @priya can you request? I'll build a vendor-compatibility matrix as part of the mitigation.

priya: creds requested and sec cleared. Proposed cadence: patch in staging Thu, canary Fri, wider rollout Mon. Weekly check-ins x5 post-release.

pager-bot: Incident INC-2026-2101 created. Severity: P2. First alert: 2026-04-18T09:03:12Z. Artifacts: /incidents/INC-2026-2101/artifacts.zip

owen: ops note: plan to add metric peer_route_mismatch_count and a lightweight probe that validates route propagation within 20s; if >20s failover to alternate egress. I'll also add a small watchdog script.

carmen: repro'd in Halcyon staging with appliance reboot sequence. Found a 12-18s window where routes were withdrawn before peer re-announcement. Opening branch fix/peer-probe-backstop and will PR tomorrow.

priya: Action items summary: 1) owen 1 peering hardening + metric (ETA 2026-04-25). 2) carmen 1 on-prem harness + PR (ETA 2026-04-23). 3) priya 1 customer comms + postmortem final (ETA 2026-04-22). Weekly check-ins Wed 16:00 PT x5. Please ack. :white_check_mark:

owen: ack :thumbsup:

carmen: ack, PR opened and tagged net-eng for review.

priya: adding recurrence rule: if >=2 customers hit same-class isolation in 30d -> auto-escalate to Isolation Squad (eng-runtime + infra + platform). Tracker entry HLY-88 created.
